title: Set up Helpdock

account.title: Create your admin account
account.description: This is the install administrator: the one account that reaches every brand and every setting. You can invite the rest of the team afterwards.
account.nameRequired: Enter the name colleagues will see.

brand.title: Your first brand
brand.description: A brand is one support desk: its own inboxes, help center, widget and agents. You can add more later.
brand.prefixHint: Tickets will look like {{example}}. Cannot be changed after creation.
brand.timezoneInvalid: Choose a timezone from the list.
brand.domainInvalid: Enter a hostname such as support.example.com.
brand.prefixTaken: That prefix is already in use on this install.

email.title: Outgoing email
email.description: Helpdock sends sign-in links, notifications and ticket replies through your own SMTP relay. You can change all of this later in Settings.
email.userOptional: (optional, for a relay that does not authenticate)
email.passwordHint: Encrypted with your master key. It is never shown again after you save.
email.fromAddressRequired: Enter the address mail will come from.
email.fromNameRequired: Enter the name recipients will see.

errors.auth-failed: The server refused those credentials. Check the username and password.
errors.connection-refused: Could not reach that server. Check the hostname and the port.
errors.tls-error: The encrypted connection failed. Try a different encryption setting.
errors.timeout: The server did not answer within ten seconds.
errors.rejected: The server refused the message. Check the From address.
errors.unknown: The test could not be completed. Check the details and try again.

done.title: Helpdock is ready
done.description: Your install is set up. Everything below can be changed later in Settings.
done.twoFactor: This install requires two-factor authentication, so you will set up an authenticator app next.

masterKey.title: Keep your master key safe.
masterKey.body: Secrets are encrypted with {{envKey}} from your {{envFile}}. If it is lost, stored credentials cannot be recovered.

failed: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
closed: This install has already been set up. Sign in instead.
throttled: Too many attempts from this address. Wait a few minutes and try again.
